text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O's debut, her first
opportunity to
put her running on
display, has arrived.

It's finally debut time... I hope
everything will be
okay...

It should so long as it goes well at the
start...
But... But, still... Ohhh...

Hyeeek! I'm so sorry... But I'm not Opera
O.

My name's Meisho Doto... I'm... one of
her
friends...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She might not see me as a friend, but I
still
came... to, well, to cheer her on...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well... I don't think she's here yet.
That's
why I'm worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's late on her first day...
Really late.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Trainer. Waiting for me? I am
positive
you were.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have purposefully made you wait, you
see.
Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How could there be? I planned this late
arrival.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As the star, how rude would it be to rob
the
supporting cast of their due
attention by taking
the stage first?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She knows she's done something wrong...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, my debut race! The day has finally
come to
reveal my beauty and stride to
the masses!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But a debut is not all that I shall be
making!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A legend... A following... And love!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Love... You're amazing, Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some people are swayed by confidence
alone.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us depart, Trainer! The era is waiting
for its
new shining star.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do not fret about the outcome. Begin

preparations for the post-race press
conference
straight away.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There must be enough seating to
accommodate
all the flocking media
reporters! Haaah ha ha ha!
